cause: Fillet radius larger than an adjacent face or edge chain, or ambiguous selection.
fix: Reduce radius below half the smallest adjacent face width; select edges narrowly; fillet last.

cause: Chamfer larger than the edge's adjacent faces.
fix: Reduce chamfer distance; chamfer before small holes are cut.

cause: Profile wire was not closed before extrude/revolve.
fix: Call .close() after polyline/lineTo sequences.

cause: Extrude called on a workplane with no 2-D sketch.
fix: Draw rect/circle/polyline on the workplane first.

cause: Boolean produced an empty result, often from non-overlapping or coincident bodies.
fix: Make tools overlap the target by ≥0.01 mm; check placement with bounding boxes.

cause: Selector string matched nothing or more than one face when one was needed.
fix: Print the selection size; use '>Z', '%CIRCLE', BoxSelector, or NearestToPointSelector.

cause: workplane() called on several non-coplanar faces.
fix: Narrow the face selection to a single face.

cause: Arc points collinear or duplicate.
fix: Use radiusArc/tangentArcPoint or check the mid point is off the chord.

cause: Profile not perpendicular to path, or a path with kinks.
fix: Place profile on a plane normal to the path start; use isFrenet=True; smooth the path with spline.

cause: Sections with incompatible vertex counts or orientation.
fix: Use ruled=True, or matching section types; ensure each section is a single closed wire.

cause: Shell thickness too large or applied after fillets.
fix: Shell before filleting; use a smaller thickness; select a single face to remove.

cause: Revolve axis given in global coordinates or crossing the profile.
fix: Axis points are in LOCAL workplane coords; profile must not cross the axis.

cause: polarArray signature misuse.
fix: polarArray(radius, startAngle, angle, count).

cause: Calling a Shape method on a Workplane (or vice versa) or a non-existent API.
fix: Use .val() to get the Shape; check KB1 for the right method name.

cause: Script forgot to assign the final object to `result`.
fix: End the script with `result = part`.

cause: Huge pattern counts, text, or recursive booleans.
fix: Union patterned tools into one compound before cutting; reduce tessellation-heavy ops.
before: for p in pts: part = part.cut(tool.translate(p))

cause: Counterbore diameter ≤ hole diameter, or depth larger than part.
fix: cboreD > d; cboreDepth < thickness.

cause: split() without a workplane through the cutting plane.
fix: Call .faces(...).workplane() or .workplane(offset=z) before split.

cause: Bodies meant to be joined do not overlap (near-miss union).
fix: Extend joining members 0.01–0.5 mm into the hub; re-check n_solids == 1.
before: arm starts exactly at hub radius

cause: Font not available in sandbox.
fix: Omit fontPath or use the default font; or skip cosmetic text.
